commits.what: kl_targeted step mode + v2v_intent_bank_term switch + trained-subset intent metric; wired through prepare_intent/BANK_OPTIONS (B==R)
CPU tests + bind_runtime validates the new keys via the B/R helpers

review follow-up: backtrack resets step_scale_mult to the accepted scale, later passes retry halvings down to the same 1/64 floor fixed mode reaches, lr-scale growth preferred (minibatch split optional, default off), per-pass param displacement + trained-subset L1 report; imitation_minibatch_split key wired (B==R); CPU tests updated + new

imitation_step_mode.kl_targeted_rule: if the accepted pass ends with KL (joint_kl vs the post-PPO snapshot, same measurement) below half the registered limit AND needed no backtrack, the next pass doubles its step scale (cap 16x base lr); after ANY backtrack the next pass restarts from the accepted scale (step_scale_mult reset), and later passes retry halvings down to the same MIN_ADDITIONAL_PASS_SCALE (1/64) floor fixed mode reaches (pass 1 keeps its 25 guaranteed halvings); existing halving backtracking unchanged; the registered KL limit 0.045 is never exceeded
imitation_step_mode.strength_rule: kl_targeted strength comes from the learning-rate scale (x16 cap); the optimizer-step growth via smaller minibatches of the same fixed permutation only runs when imitation_minibatch_split is enabled (default False: smaller minibatches add noise, not data)
imitation_step_mode.per_pass_report_note: param_displacement is the accepted policy's L2 movement vs its pre-pass snapshot; l1_action_error_trained_before/after are the bank_imitation L1 estimator on the TRAINED subset (w>0, executed, present members) - together they show live whether more movement lowers action error (kl_targeted rows only; fixed rows keep the old keys)
imitation_step_mode.enablement: registered flip of BANK_OPTIONS['imitation_step_mode'] (+ deployed runtime) at a registered update boundary; B and R move together (bind_runtime refuses any B/R mismatch; optional *_by_arm mapping accepted only when B == R == the key)
wiring: bank_imitation.run_separate(step_mode=..., falls back to the installed runtime value)

v2v_intent_bank_term.false_drops: the v2v_intent bank intent term is removed from the run_separate imitation loss (legacy run() unchanged)
wiring: bank_imitation.run_separate(intent_bank_term=..., falls back to the installed runtime value)

imitation_minibatch_split.default_note: false (default): kl_targeted passes keep the fixed mode minibatching (128-pair splits of the same fixed permutation) and grow only the learning-rate scale (cap 16x); true additionally doubles optimizer steps via minibatch 128//steps_mult (cap 4x)
wiring: bank_imitation.run_separate(minibatch_split=..., falls back to the installed runtime value)

keys.intent_metric_honesty: exact_grade.exact_update reports the bank intent loss on the TRAINED subset (w>0, trainable pairs) as v2v_intent.before_trained/after_trained (bank_imitation.trainable) alongside the all-pairs before/after
